part2_448.knn_search: exhaustive squared L2, k=1, no approximate search

protocol.alignment: sample coarse tokens bilinearly at fine patch centers using uncropped resized dimensions and top-left crop, clamping at coarse grid edges
protocol.fusion: L2-normalize each aligned scale, concatenate with equal sqrt(0.5) weights, and match one joint reference patch
protocol.foreground_mask: the official PCA mask on unmodified 672 final-layer features for both new variants
protocol.map_reconstruction: identical official original-resolution renderer with sigma 4
protocol.selection: fixed before new test outputs; previous VisA results informed the failure hypothesis; no test-label parameter sweep
